description: Bounds of the display glyph pass, which pins a short oversized character run drawn inside running text -- a feature number set several times the body size in the reading order of a contents blurb -- at its source coordinates and size instead of letting the typesetter re-set it. display_glyph_max_chars is the longest such a run may be: one to a few characters is a number or a mark, anything longer is a heading that happens to be large and belongs to the flow. The size threshold is not declared here: the pass reads min_first_run_size_ratio from configs/drop_cap.json, the single source of that number (span_merge reads it the same way), applied against the paragraph's own median character size -- a paragraph set large throughout has a ratio of one against itself and is never touched. The jurisdiction boundary with the drop cap lane is positional and fixed by pipeline order: a qualifying run beginning at the paragraph's first visible character is an opening initial's shape and is left for the drop cap lane, recorded as refused here. A pinned run becomes a paragraph labelled display_glyph, protected as a fixed asset of class display_glyph, and the clearance capture and the overlap detector read it through the one enumerator fixed_assets.display_glyph_paragraphs. switch names the run attribute the pass is read from.
